business_summary: Many Idea Cloud Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides integrated marketing services. It also offers brand marketing, public relations, event planning services, media advertising services, software as a service, and interactive marketing services. The company was formerly known as Many Idea Interactive Technology Holdings Limited. Many Idea Cloud Holdings Limited was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Xiamen, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: 투자지주회사인 다수의 Idea Cloud Holdings Limited는 통합 마케팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 브랜드 마케팅, 홍보, 이벤트 기획 서비스, 미디어 광고 서비스, 서비스형 소프트웨어 및 대화형 마케팅 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에는 Many Idea Interactive Technology Holdings Limited로 알려졌습니다. Many Idea Cloud Holdings Limited는 2012년에 설립되었으며 중국 샤먼에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
